justification: Emit stages ARE the filesystem adapter — they exist to materialise pipeline output on disk.  Same chicken-and-egg pattern as forme-source-fs: ctx.filesystem is the orchestrator-provided FilesystemApi, but for forme-emit-fs to write disk *something* has to be the implementation.  Pragmatic v0 resolution mirrors source-fs: declare the capability here (manifest audit layer) and read via node:fs/promises directly.  When FM02 lands and the orchestrator wires real FilesystemApis around stages, forme-emit-fs becomes one of the implementations rather than a consumer.  Stage-level exception documented in README and source.
